verdict.rationale: Numeral's own materials claim each element of the story: it will "register, file, and remit across US and global jurisdictions, on time, every time", it lists Autofile and Autoregister, and it guarantees that it will pay penalties and interest if a filing is late. Recorded transactions feed the filings, and the MCP docs mention filings "waiting on my review", which suggests a possible approval step rather than fully hands-off filing. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the filing and remittance workflow and the guarantee's terms, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that filings are actually on time in every jurisdiction.
